study type: Cross-sectional substudy of a prospective population-based cohort study
outcome: Electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters (PR-interval, QRS duration, R-wave amplitude in V6)
cohort: Newborns from the general population diagnosed with bicuspid aortic valve within 30 days after birth, matched with newborns with structurally normal hearts.
finding: Newborns with bicuspid aortic valve initially showed a slightly longer PR-interval, longer QRS duration, and lower maximum R-wave amplitude in V6 compared to controls, but these differences became non-significant after correction for multiple testing.
